Suncor Energy INC New (SU) Share Value Declined While Locust Wood Capital Advisers LLC Trimmed Position 
April 18, 2018 - By Nellie Frank 
Stephen J. Errico decreased its stake in Suncor Energy Inc New (SU) by 10.51% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Locust Wood Capital Advisers Llc sold 151,938 shares as the company’s stock declined 2.02% with the market. The hedge fund run by Stephen J. Errico held 1.29M shares of the integrated oil company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $47.49 million, down from 1.45M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Locust Wood Capital Advisers Llc who had been investing in Suncor Energy Inc New for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $60.24 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.95% or $0.36 during the last trading session, reaching $38.22. About 834,930 shares traded. Suncor Energy Inc. (NYSE:SU) has risen 13.82% since April 18, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 2.27% the S&P500. 
Locust Wood Capital Advisers Llc, which manages about $781.63 million and $1.08B US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Comcast Corp New (NASDAQ:CMCSA) by 784,405 shares to 1.31 million shares, valued at $52.37M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 115,230 shares in the quarter, for a total of 309,021 shares, and has risen its stake in Vantiv Inc (NYSE:VNTV). 
Analysts await Suncor Energy Inc. (NYSE:SU) to report earnings on May, 1 after the close. They expect $0.46 EPS, up 24.32 % or $0.09 from last year’s $0.37 per share. SU’s profit will be $725.05 million for 20.77 P/E if the $0.46 EPS becomes a reality. After $0.62 actual EPS reported by Suncor Energy Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -25.81 % negative EPS growth. Suncor Energy Inc. (NYSE:SU) Ratings Coverage

The rating was maintained by Morgan Stanley on Monday, April 16 with “Overweight”. The rating was maintained by Bank of America on Thursday, April 5 with “Buy”. Piper Jaffray maintained Suncor Energy Inc. (NYSE:SU) on Thursday, January 11 with “Buy” rating. The rating was upgraded by TD Securities to “Buy” on Friday, February 9. The firm has “Buy” rating given on Friday, February 9 by Piper Jaffray. The rating was maintained by Piper Jaffray with “Buy” on Tuesday, January 23.
